question: Does the coupled pre/post-GELU frame capacity transfer when trained causally inside the original 124M 0.5-TPP budget together with the accepted c_proj Muon error-feedback mechanism?
scientific_scope: one smallest-rung same-token-budget causal transfer test; not a learning-rate sweep and not a fitted scaling ladder

capacity_evidence.limitation: 31,457,280 extra endpoint optimization tokens; cannot be counted as same-budget improvement

candidate.base: accepted full-attention replacement plus Muon-matched hidden64+24 c_proj with decay-1 compression error feedback; c_fc remains dense
candidate.pregelu_frame: two-stage fixed-basis block32/basis256 rotation, coordinate scale 4, seed 161803
candidate.postgelu_hidden_frame: two-stage fixed-basis block32/basis256 rotation, coordinate scale 4, seed 314159
candidate.residual_output_frame: four-stage fixed-basis block32/basis256 rotation, coordinate scale 4, seed 271828
candidate.initialization: exact zero coordinates; mathematical identity with registered bounded FHT roundoff

training.frame_optimizer: AdamW fallback, betas 0.9/0.95, zero chart weight decay

decision_rule.pass: stable terminal validation CE at or below 5.522365207672119, improving the accepted causal parent by at least 0.005
decision_rule.near_close: terminal validation CE at or below 5.5018, within 0.01 CE of attention-only
decision_rule.close: terminal validation CE at or below 5.4968, within 0.005 CE of attention-only
decision_rule.reject: instability, incomplete exact-resume state, MFU below 20 percent, or terminal validation CE above 5.522365207672119

performance_and_correctness_gate.preflight: one warmup plus eight timed exact training updates on PRO6 GPU0
required: all local and remote focused chart/cache tests pass
exact training config and source/config/dataset identities are bound
all three frame groups receive finite nonzero gradients
MuonMatchedGivensLinear c_proj receives its projected dense gradient and applies error feedback
one interrupted two-step exact-resume test is bitwise identical for model, optimizer, RNG, and frame coordinates
measured exact-path MFU is at least 20 percent

required_artifacts: git commit, entrypoint, literal command, config and source hashes
terminal log, status, checkpoint, and exact custom optimizer state hashes
